title: Inspection: the bound objects of a Godot project at one tick of a replay
description: Written by expectrail.inspection.document (`expectrail inspect --project GAME --at-tick N --json`) and read by expectrail.inspection.problems. It is what the engine reported for each object the project config binds, at one physics tick of a headless replay of one route: the node path, the box in captured-frame pixels, the box in world units and the engine's visible flag. It is setup information, not a verdict and not pixel evidence: a box is the bounds of the object's drawing (or, labelled, its collision shape), not its opaque pixels, and visible is the engine's flag, not a claim that anything was seen on screen. A bound role with no object at that tick is listed under absent, never given a box.

entryScene.description: The config's entryScene, or null when it names none and the project's main scene ran.

configSha256.description: SHA-256 of the expectrail.project.json bytes whose bindings were replayed.

gameTree.description: The replay's digest of the game folder it copied (replay.json game.tree).

from.description: config: the first route the project config lists; argument: the --route given.

tick.description: The physics tick inspected, counted from 0.

lastTick.description: The last tick the replay recorded. tick is never past it.

viewport.description: The captured frame's size in pixels, as the replay recorded it.

node.description: The node's path from the current scene.

generation.description: 1 for the first node seen at this path; 2 and on for a later node at the same path (a respawn).

box.description: Left, top, right, bottom in captured-frame pixels, through the camera of the following tick, as the trace records it.

worldBox.description: Left, top, right, bottom in world units.

visible.description: The engine's visible flag for the whole instance. Not a claim about pixels, alpha or occlusion.

onScreen.description: True exactly when box overlaps the viewport. A reader recomputes it.

selector.description: node:PATH or group:NAME, as the config binds the role.

absent.description: Bound roles with no object at this tick: not spawned yet, removed, or a group with no members. Never given a box.
